candidates.description: This feature vector represents numbers, punctuation, and common word fragments in the Hindi language.
This vector represents punctuation marks, parentheses, and common subword units or characters in Hindi script.
This feature vector activates strongly on characters, syllables, and subwords from Indic scripts like Hindi, particularly associated with names or terms related to Hindu mythology.
This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments from multilingual text processing.
This vector represents common character combinations, suffixes, and syllabic fragments found in Hindi script.
This vector is related to Hindi consonant characters combined with the anusvara diacritic (bindu).
This vector activates for common Devanagari script characters and consonant-vowel combinations predominantly found in Hindi words.
This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel sign and dependent vowel markers combined with punctuation marks.
This vector represents common conjunct consonants, vowel signs, and numbers in the Hindi Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates strongly on common sub-word tokens, characters, and syllables in Hindi script.
